actions.name: divine awareness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows if it hears a lie.

actions.name: exalted restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item Flying Sword]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Slaying Bow]].

actions.name: slaying bow
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=C7BMf8hIfCjxRSWC]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=C7BMf8hIfCjxRSWC]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=C7BMf8hIfCjxRSWC]] [[lookup @range.units activity=C7BMf8hIfCjxRSWC]]. Failure: If the [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=C7BMf8hIfCjxRSWC]] has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes [[/damage average]] damage.

actions.name: flying sword
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. Hit or Miss: The sword magically returns to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s hand or hovers within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectEvil]{Detect Evil and Good} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommune000]{Commune}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWea]{Control Weather}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelEvil]{Dispel Evil and Good}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplResurrecti]{Resurrection}

actions.name: blinding gaze
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]] feet. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: radiant teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports up to [[lookup @range.value activity=HtsFBK1PYKjvy9mn]] feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=HtsFBK1PYKjvy9mn]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=HtsFBK1PYKjvy9mn]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} at its destination space. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: divine aid
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Cure Wounds} (level 2 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{Lesser Restoration}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRemoveCurs]{Remove Curse}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
